message:
feat(weapon): hold two weapons in a Loadout and change between them

Weapon reads the active slot of a Loadout and gains a SWITCHING state,
equip(), fill(), and pellets that sum into one hit for each zombie.
Arsenal replaces WeaponDef.starting_pistol() with the six weapons of the
design, and each WeaponDef carries its view model parts and muzzle.
Weapon loses def, magazine, reserve, and refill(); round start no
longer refills the ammunition.
